_zweck: Werkzeuge des Mira-Agenten (Plan bubble/mira_agent_22_10, Entscheidung Q4): je Werkzeug die App-Funktion(en), die die UI selbst ruft, mit Parametern fuer das Modell. Eine neue Version einer Funktion wird HIER im selben Commit nachgezogen wie in der UI; .check_mira_werkzeuge.py bricht sonst ab. Beschreibungen englisch (das Modell liest sie).

date_from.beschreibung: First day of the period, a Berlin calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD). Pass both dates or neither. Neither = the last 30 days up to today, the same window in every tool. Only one date = the other falls back to the function's own default (date_to: today; date_from: a 30-day window ending at date_to, but only 7 days in the sources_* tools), so results of different tools would not be comparable. At most 366 days (prompts and prompt_groups: 400).

date_to.beschreibung: Last day of the period, inclusive (Berlin calendar day, at most tomorrow). Pass together with date_from. Tools with *_prev / *_delta fields compare against the period directly before date_from, which is half as long (1 to 30 days), not of equal length.

models.beschreibung: AI models to include, by lowercase key: chatgpt, google-aio (Google AI Overviews), perplexity, gemini, deepseek. Omit for all models. A model the team does not track returns no data, not an error.

markets.beschreibung: Markets to include, by two-letter country code (DE, US, ...). The market belongs to the prompt (each prompt runs in one market), not to the answer. Omit for all markets.

topic_ids.beschreibung: Topics to include, by topic id (tag_id from prompts_meta; search_entities does not find topics). Unknown or other-team ids return an error. Filters by the prompts' current topic assignment, also for past answers. Omit for all prompts.

topic_mode.beschreibung: How several topic_ids combine: or = prompts in at least one of the topics, and = prompts in all of them. Only matters with two or more topics.

intents.beschreibung: Prompt intents to include (the purpose of the prompt, classified per prompt). Omit for all. Passing all four values is the same as no filter and also keeps prompts that are not classified yet.

branded.beschreibung: Branded prompts are prompts whose own text names one of the team's tracked brands (prompts not yet checked count as non-branded). They are excluded by default (non_branded), like everywhere in the app, so all counts and rates leave them out. Use all (every prompt) or branded (only those) only when the user asks for branded prompts, and then say that they are included.

werkzeuge.name: search_entities
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Look up ids by name or text: tracked brands (own brand and active competitors; id = company_id), active prompts (id = prompt_id), and domains and URLs that the team's AI answers have cited (no id: the domain or URL string itself is the key). Case-, accent- and umlaut-insensitive substring match, exact and prefix matches first; www. and https:// variants of a host find the same domain. Does NOT find abbreviations of a brand (VW for Volkswagen: look in brands_tracked), topics (use prompts_meta), inactive or untracked brands (brands_tracked lists inactive ones) or inactive prompts; newly cited domains and URLs can take up to 10 minutes to appear. Hits come as one list grouped by type: brand {id, name}, domain {domain}, url {url, title}, prompt {id, prompt_text, market}. Only call it when a tool needs an id you do not have; list and overview tools already return names with ids.

query.beschreibung: Search text, at least 2 characters (shorter returns nothing): a brand name, words from a prompt, a domain (adac.de) or a URL.

scope.beschreibung: Restrict to one kind. Omit to search all four kinds.

limit.beschreibung: Maximum hits per kind (not in total), 1-20.

werkzeuge.name: brands_overview
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Brand leaderboard for the period: every active tracked brand (own and competitors) with visibility_pct (share of answers that name the brand, in %), avg_rank (mean of the brand's best position per answer; positions count all brands named in the answer incl. untracked ones, 1 = named first, lower is better), sentiment (0-100, only over the last 30 days of the period), mentions (number of answers naming the brand, not the number of name mentions) and position (place in the full ranking by visibility, independent of order, search, brand_ids and paging). *_prev / *_delta compare with the period directly before date_from, which is half as long (1 to 30 days): visibility_delta_pct in percentage points, avg_rank_delta in rank points (positive = worse), sentiment_delta in points; null when that period had no answers. mentions_prev counts over that shorter period, so never compare it with mentions directly. Each brand counts only inside its tracking window; visibility_pct null = no answers in its window, which is not 0 %. own = the own brand, always present and unaffected by search, brand_ids and paging; field = brand_count, best_rank and the unweighted avg_sentiment of all brands. With prompt_id all numbers are for that one prompt. For trends over time use brands_visibility_trend, for numbers per prompt prompts.

order.beschreibung: Sort order of rows (position does not change). visibility_delta_* sorts by visibility_delta_pct, brands without a previous value last; rank_asc = best rank first.

limit.beschreibung: Rows per page, 1-50; meta.total_count = all matching brands.

offset.beschreibung: Rows to skip for paging. Default 0.

search.beschreibung: Only brands whose name contains this text (case-insensitive; umlaut spellings like ue/oe/ae also match).

brand_ids.beschreibung: Only these brands in rows (company ids; max 50); own stays complete regardless. Inactive brands return no row; unknown or other-team ids return an error.

prompt_id.beschreibung: Restrict all numbers (rows and own) to this one prompt. A deleted or other-team prompt returns an error.

werkzeuge.name: brands_visibility_trend
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Visibility over time per brand (line chart, trend questions). companies[] = the brands shown with position, color and their visibility_pct / avg_rank for the whole period (same values as brands_overview). series[] = one entry per brand and bucket: bucket (start), bucket_from / bucket_to, partial (bucket cut by the period), visibility_pct, avg_rank, runs_with (answers naming the brand), runs_total (answers). visibility_pct and avg_rank are null where a bucket had no answers or lies outside the brand's tracking window: a gap, not 0. Without brand_ids it shows the top series_limit brands by visibility and always includes the own brand (top N-1 plus own). series is sorted by brand, then bucket, and the tool shows at most 50 entries: for long periods use week or month, or fewer brands. For one value per brand use brands_overview.

granularity.beschreibung: Bucket size: day, week (ISO week from Monday) or month (calendar month). The first and last bucket can be partial.

brand_ids.beschreibung: Exactly these brands (company ids, max 10); the own brand only if included. series_limit is then ignored.

series_limit.beschreibung: Without brand_ids: number of brands shown, 1-10, the top brands by visibility with the own brand always among them.

werkzeuge.name: explain_change
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Why a brand's Visibility changed between the period and the comparison period, in one call. Use it first for any why question about a rise or fall (why did my Visibility drop, what happened since a date, why is competitor X growing) and add other tools only for what it leaves open. meta: period and comparison period with their length in days (days, prev_days; the comparison period is usually half as long), topic_overlap (topics share prompts, so topic contributions overlap), omitted (groups left out and their contribution). total: visibility_pct and visibility_prev_pct with delta_pct, avg_rank and sentiment with previous values, mentions and runs also per day: compare per day, never raw counts across the two periods. weekly: the brand's Visibility per week over both windows (window prev or now), to say when it changed. change_point: the week-to-week move that carries the change (weeks, Visibility before and after). by_model and by_topic, per group: runs_share_pct / runs_share_prev_pct (share of the tracked answers), visibility_pct / visibility_prev_pct, rate_effect_pct (change of the brand inside the group), mix_effect_pct (answers shifting into groups where the brand is weaker or stronger) and contribution_pct (their sum; the models add up to the total change). prompts_lost / prompts_gained: the prompts whose mention rate moved most (text, topics, runs, mention_rate_pct / mention_rate_prev_pct, impact_pct, top_competitor_gain = the competitor that gained most in that prompt); prompts_added / prompts_removed: prompts that ran in only one of the windows. own_domains and own_pages: the brand's own cited domains and URLs with share_pct / share_prev_pct (share of answers with citations), last_cited_on and runs_last_7d. pages_naming_brand: share of answers with citations that cite a page naming the brand, now and before, with top_lost (those pages that lost most). competitors: tracked brands whose Visibility moved most. Not for one value per brand (brands_overview) or a long trend (brands_visibility_trend).

aufrufe.nur_mira: Ursachen einer Veraenderung in einem Aufruf (Warum-Fragen); die UI hat dafuer keine Ansicht (22.10.)

brand_id.beschreibung: company_id of a tracked brand of the team, own or competitor (from search_entities, brands_tracked or a previous result). Omit for the own brand.

werkzeuge.name: brand_detail
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Header facts of one brand, without period and without numbers: name, domain, role (own or competitor), status (active or inactive), color, tracked_since (start of its current or last tracking window), last_mentioned_at (last answer naming it; intents and branded only affect this field), deactivated_at. Works for inactive brands too. Numbers come from other tools: brands_overview with brand_ids [id], brands_visibility_trend, responses with brand_id (its answers), sources_domains / sources_urls with brand_id (sources cited in its answers), brand_name_variations (its spellings).

brand_id.beschreibung: company_id of a brand of the team, active or inactive (from search_entities, brands_tracked or a previous result). Unknown or other-team id: not found.

werkzeuge.name: brand_name_variations
werkzeuge.beschreibung: How AI answers spell or name one tracked brand. One row per spelling (case differences merged): name (most frequent spelling), mentioned_count (name mentions), mentioned_runs (answers containing it), share_of_voice_pct = share of THIS brand's own mentions (meta.mentions_total), not the brand's share of voice against competitors. Sorted by mentioned_count. Only answers inside the brand's tracking window count. An inactive brand returns a not-found error. Not for brand KPIs (brands_overview).

brand_id.beschreibung: company_id of an active tracked brand (own or competitor). Inactive or other-team brand: not found.

limit.beschreibung: Rows per page, 1-200; meta.total_count = all spellings.

offset.beschreibung: Rows to skip for paging. Default 0.

werkzeuge.name: brands_tracked
werkzeuge.beschreibung: The team's brands without numbers: brands[] = all active tracked brands, own brand first (company_id, name, role own or competitor, domain, color); inactive[] = deactivated brands (company_id, name, domain, deactivated_at); meta with counts, quota {used, total, remaining, plan} (active competitors against the plan limit; the own brand does not count) and today's remaining daily limits. No period, no filters. Use it to list or resolve brands, also inactive ones, which search_entities does not find.

werkzeuge.name: prompts
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Prompt list with numbers per prompt plus the totals row for the same filters. Result: liste (rows; meta.total_count; meta.counts = active, inactive and untagged prompts under the same filters) and summe (totals row). Per row: runs_total (answers in the period), mentioned_runs (answers naming the OWN brand), visibility_pct (= mentioned_runs / runs_total, null without answers), avg_rank (own brand, mean best position per answer, lower is better), avg_sentiment (own brand, only the last 30 days of the period), top_mentions (up to 5 tracked brands named most often in this prompt, with mention_runs and mentioned_pct; most often named, not best Rank), companies_mentioned_count, tags, intent, branded, last_seen_run_at (last answer that named the own brand). Own-brand numbers count only answers inside the own brand's tracking window. summe: visibility_pct (weighted by answers), prompts_mentioned / prompts_zero_vis (prompts whose answers did / never named the own brand), avg_rank, rank1_count and rank_top3_count (number of PROMPTS whose rank is 1.0 / at most 3.0, not answers), avg_sentiment, sentiment_below_50 (PROMPTS with average sentiment below 50), topics_used, avg_brands_per_prompt, competitors_seen, top_intent / top_market with their share of prompts, markets_used, newest_created, added_last_7d. Branded prompts are excluded by default, so counts can be lower than in prompts_meta. One prompt in detail: prompt_detail; groups: prompt_groups. When not: for overall Brand numbers and trends use brands_overview; for what the AI answers say use responses and response_detail; to map a prompt the user describes in own words use prompts_catalog.

search.beschreibung: Only prompts whose text contains this text (case- and accent-insensitive substring).

mentioned.beschreibung: yes = prompts with at least one answer in the period that names the OWN brand; no = prompts whose answers never name it, including prompts without any answer in the period. For other brands use brand_ids; both together = AND.

brand_ids.beschreibung: Only prompts with at least one answer in the period that names one of these tracked brands (company ids, any of them; max 50). Combined with mentioned by AND.

status.beschreibung: active = prompts that currently run, inactive = paused prompts, all = both.

untagged.beschreibung: true = only prompts without any active topic. Cannot be combined with topic_ids (error).

order.beschreibung: Sort order; prompts without a value go last. visibility_asc, rank_desc and sentiment_asc put the weakest first; rank_asc = best rank first.

limit.beschreibung: Rows per page, 1-50; liste.meta.total_count = all matching prompts.

offset.beschreibung: Rows to skip for paging. Default 0.

werkzeuge.name: prompt_groups
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Prompts grouped by topic or by intent. One row per group with prompts_count (active prompts), prompts_count_inactive, runs_total and the OWN brand's visibility_pct, avg_rank and avg_sentiment, weighted by answers, over the prompts that pass the filters and status. By topic: one row per active topic, plus untagged (prompts without topic) last; a prompt with several topics counts in each of them, so groups overlap and must not be added up. By intent: always the four intents (also with 0 prompts), plus pending (not yet classified) when present. Topic groups are sorted by visibility. For single prompts use prompts.

group_by.beschreibung: topic = one group per active topic plus untagged; intent = one group per prompt intent.

search.beschreibung: Only prompts whose text contains this text (case- and accent-insensitive substring).

mentioned.beschreibung: yes = prompts with at least one answer in the period that names the OWN brand; no = prompts whose answers never name it, including prompts without any answer in the period. For other brands use brand_ids; both together = AND.

brand_ids.beschreibung: Only prompts with at least one answer in the period that names one of these tracked brands (company ids, any of them; max 50). Combined with mentioned by AND.

status.beschreibung: active = prompts that currently run, inactive = paused prompts, all = both. prompts_count always counts active prompts.

werkzeuge.name: prompts_meta
werkzeuge.beschreibung: The team's prompt setup without numbers or period: topics (active topics with tag_id = the id for topic_ids, name, prompt_count_active, prompt_count_inactive), intent_counts of active prompts (informational, recommendation, transactional, other, pending = not yet classified), markets with prompt counts, the prompt quota (prompts_limit, prompts_active, prompts_remaining, prompts_inactive) and the user's role. Counts include branded prompts. Use it to resolve topic names to ids and for 'how many prompts / topics do we have'. Users also call Topics categories, themes, segments or clusters (Kategorie, Thema, Segment); match them by meaning.

werkzeuge.name: prompts_catalog
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Lightweight list of the team's Prompts without metrics: id, text, market, topics (id, name), intent (pending when not classified yet), branded, status, created_at; newest first, up to 300 per call, meta.total_count and has_more. Use it to map a Prompt the user describes in their own words to the real Prompt by meaning (synonyms, translations, other wording), or to list the Prompts of a Topic; then use the id with prompts, prompt_detail, sources_* or responses. For Visibility, Rank and Sentiment per Prompt use prompts. search_entities finds at most 20 Prompts by text match.

aufrufe.nur_mira: Nachfolger von prompt_lookup (n8n); die UI braucht keinen Katalog ohne Kennzahlen (22.10.)

status.beschreibung: active (default; only active Prompts count in the app), inactive or all. Deleted Prompts never appear.

search.beschreibung: Only Prompts containing this text (case and accents ignored), as on the Prompts page.

limit.beschreibung: Rows per call, 1-300; meta.has_more says whether more exist.

offset.beschreibung: Rows to skip for paging. Default 0.

werkzeuge.name: prompt_detail
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Header facts of one prompt, without period and without numbers: prompt_text, market, topics (tags), status (active or paused; paused_reason plan_limit), created_at, last_run_at, next_run_at, intent, branded with the brands that make it branded, and models = the AI models the team tracks (not results per model). For its numbers call brands_overview, brands_visibility_trend, sources_domains, sources_urls or responses with prompt_id.

prompt_id.beschreibung: Prompt id from search_entities, prompts or a previous result. Deleted or other-team prompt: not found.

werkzeuge.name: sources_domains
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Cited domains (hosts; each subdomain is its own domain, www. removed) and how often AI answers cite them, plus the totals row. Result: liste (rows; meta.total_count; meta.runs_with_any = answers with at least one citation, the denominator) and summe. share_pct = answers citing the domain / answers with at least one citation, in %: answer-based, so the shares of all domains add up to more than 100. share_prev_pct / share_delta_pct = the same for the period directly before date_from (half as long, 1 to 30 days), delta in percentage points. runs_with_domain = answers citing it; used_total = citations (answer x URL pairs: an answer citing 3 of its pages counts 3); urls_count = its cited URLs in the period; citation_type = who owns the source (You = own site, Competition = a tracked competitor's site, Editorial, UGC_Community, Knowledge_Base, Brand_Platform, Institutional, Misc); is_mentioned = at least one of its cited pages names the OWN brand in its content (with brand_id: that brand); first_used_at / last_used_at = first and last citation inside the period. summe: own_share_pct (citations of domains of type You / all citations: citation-based and about own sites, not about pages naming the brand), top10_share_pct, citations_total, avg_citations_per_domain, top_type / top_type_share / types_used, active_last_7d, new_in_period (domains not cited before the period). summe ignores brand_id and prompt_id. With mentioned or mentioned_brand_ids it answers which sources name a brand on the page.

mentioned.beschreibung: Page-level, not answer-level: yes / no = only domains where at least one cited page (in the period) names / no cited page names the OWN brand in its content. With brand_id set it refers to THAT brand in the list (the totals row keeps the own brand). For other brands use mentioned_brand_ids; both together = AND. Pages that could not be analysed count as not naming the brand, so no is not proof of absence.

mentioned_brand_ids.beschreibung: Only domains with at least one cited page (in the period) whose content names one of these tracked brands (company ids, any of them). Page-level, not answer-level.

citation_types.beschreibung: Only sources whose domain has one of these citation types (who owns the source): You = own site incl. its subdomains, Competition = a tracked competitor's site, Misc = not classified; the others are categories of third-party sites.

search.beschreibung: Only domains whose host contains this text (e.g. reddit, youtu).

order.beschreibung: Sort order. share_* sorts by answers citing the domain, share_delta_* by the change in percentage points (no previous value last), urls_count_* by cited URLs.

limit.beschreibung: Rows per page, 1-50; liste.meta.total_count = all matching domains.

offset.beschreibung: Rows to skip for paging. Default 0.

prompt_id.beschreibung: Only citations from answers to this one prompt. The totals row (summe) ignores it.

brand_id.beschreibung: Only citations from answers in which this brand is named; shares then use those answers as denominator. is_mentioned and the mentioned filter then refer to THIS brand, not the own brand. The totals row (summe) ignores brand_id and keeps all answers and the own brand.

werkzeuge.name: sources_urls
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Cited URLs (exact pages, normalised: https, no www., no tracking parameters) and how often AI answers cite them, plus the totals row. Result: liste (rows; meta.total_count; meta.runs_with_any = the denominator) and summe. global_share_pct = answers citing the URL / answers with at least one citation, in % (answer-based, adds up to more than 100); share_prev_pct / share_delta_pct = the same for the period directly before date_from (half as long, 1 to 30 days), delta in percentage points; domainshare_pct = answers citing this URL / answers citing its domain; runs_with_url; title; citation_type (owner of its domain); url_type (kind of page; uncategorized = not classified); is_mentioned = the page content names the OWN brand (with brand_id: that brand); mentions[] = up to 4 tracked brands named on the page (own first) with mentions_total; first_used_at / last_used_at inside the period. summe: own_share_pct (citations of URLs on own sites, type You / all citations), top10_share_pct, top_url_type / top_url_type_share, mention_rate_pct (share of the listed URLs whose page names the own brand, counted per URL), avg_brands_per_url, brands_seen, active_last_7d, new_in_period. summe ignores brand_id and prompt_id. Use for which pages are cited, page types and which brands appear on cited pages; one URL in depth: url_detail.

mentioned.beschreibung: Page-level, not answer-level: yes / no = only URLs whose page content names / does not name the OWN brand. With brand_id set it refers to THAT brand in the list (the totals row keeps the own brand). For other brands use mentioned_brand_ids; both together = AND. Pages that could not be analysed count as not naming the brand, so no is not proof of absence.

mentioned_brand_ids.beschreibung: Only URLs whose page content names at least one of these tracked brands (company ids, any of them). Page-level, not answer-level.

citation_types.beschreibung: Only sources whose domain has one of these citation types (who owns the source): You = own site incl. its subdomains, Competition = a tracked competitor's site, Misc = not classified; the others are categories of third-party sites.

url_types.beschreibung: Only URLs of these page kinds (what the page is, independent of who owns it, e.g. listicle, review, forum); uncategorized = page without a type yet.

search.beschreibung: Only URLs containing this text (searches the URL, not the title).

order.beschreibung: Sort order. share_* sorts by answers citing the URL, share_delta_* by the change in percentage points (no previous value last), domain_asc / url_asc alphabetically.

limit.beschreibung: Rows per page, 1-50; liste.meta.total_count = all matching URLs.

offset.beschreibung: Rows to skip for paging. Default 0.

prompt_id.beschreibung: Only citations from answers to this one prompt. The totals row (summe) ignores it.

brand_id.beschreibung: Only citations from answers in which this brand is named; shares then use those answers as denominator. is_mentioned and the mentioned filter then refer to THIS brand, not the own brand. The totals row (summe) ignores brand_id and keeps all answers and the own brand.

werkzeuge.name: sources_domain_urls
werkzeuge.beschreibung: The cited URLs of ONE domain (drill-down after sources_domains), with the same row fields as sources_urls. domainshare_pct = answers citing the URL / answers citing the domain (meta.runs_with_domain); global_share_pct and share_delta_pct refer to all answers with a citation (delta in percentage points against the period before, half as long). is_mentioned = the page content names the OWN brand. No totals row, no prompt_id, no brand_id.

domain.beschreibung: The domain, e.g. adac.de; a URL or a www. form is reduced to the host. Each subdomain is its own domain (blog.x.com is not x.com).

mentioned.beschreibung: Page-level, not answer-level: yes / no = only URLs whose page content names / does not name the OWN brand. For other brands use mentioned_brand_ids; both together = AND. Pages that could not be analysed count as not naming the brand.

mentioned_brand_ids.beschreibung: Only URLs whose page content names at least one of these tracked brands (company ids, any of them). Page-level, not answer-level.

url_types.beschreibung: Only URLs of these page kinds (what the page is, independent of who owns it, e.g. listicle, review, forum); uncategorized = page without a type yet.

search.beschreibung: Only URLs containing this text (searches the URL, not the title).

order.beschreibung: Sort order. domainshare_* sorts by answers citing the URL, share_delta_* by the change of its global share in percentage points.

limit.beschreibung: Rows per page, 1-50; meta.total_count = all matching URLs of the domain.

offset.beschreibung: Rows to skip for paging. Default 0.

werkzeuge.name: sources_trend
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Citation share over time for the top domains (mode domain) or top URLs (mode url), plus kpis and the split by type. kpis: runs_with_any (answers with at least one citation), citations_total (answer x URL pairs), domains_total, urls_total. series[] = the top series_limit domains or URLs by share, with share_pct over the whole period. timeseries[] = one entry per key and bucket, share_pct = answers citing it / answers with a citation in that bucket (0 when the bucket has none). types[] = share of CITATIONS per type, adding up to 100: citation types in domain mode, URL page types in url mode; the type filter of the kind shown is not applied to types[], and url_types are ignored completely in domain mode. The tool shows at most 50 timeseries entries: for long periods use week or month or a smaller series_limit. series_limit 0 returns only kpis and types.

mode.beschreibung: domain = series per domain and split by citation type; url = series per URL and split by page type.

granularity.beschreibung: Bucket size: day, week (ISO week from Monday) or month (calendar month).

series_limit.beschreibung: Number of top domains or URLs with a time series, 0-10; 0 = only kpis and types.

mentioned.beschreibung: Page-level, not answer-level: yes / no = only sources whose cited pages name / do not name the OWN brand in their content (for a domain: at least one of its URLs). With brand_id set it refers to THAT brand. For other brands use mentioned_brand_ids; both together = AND.

mentioned_brand_ids.beschreibung: Only sources whose cited pages name at least one of these tracked brands (company ids, any of them); for a domain, at least one of its URLs. Page-level, not answer-level.

citation_types.beschreibung: Only sources whose domain has one of these citation types (who owns the source): You = own site incl. its subdomains, Competition = a tracked competitor's site, Misc = not classified; the others are categories of third-party sites. In domain mode this does not narrow types[].

url_types.beschreibung: Only URLs of these page kinds; uncategorized = page without a type yet. Ignored in domain mode; in url mode it does not narrow types[].

prompt_id.beschreibung: Only citations from answers to this one prompt.

brand_id.beschreibung: Only citations from answers in which this brand is named; shares then use those answers as denominator, and the mentioned filter refers to this brand.

werkzeuge.name: sources_brands
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Tracked Brands named on cited pages (page content, not the AI answers) and cited sources ordered by how many Brands their pages name. Successor of the old on-source presence view. mode brands: one row per tracked Brand of the team (own and competitors, also with 0): urls_count = cited URLs in the filter whose page names the Brand, url_share_pct = their share of all cited URLs, domains_count, runs_with_pages = AI answers citing at least one of these pages, share_pct = those answers / answers with any citation (answer-based, so Brands add up to more than 100), share_prev_pct / share_delta_pct = the same for the period directly before (half as long, 1 to 30 days; delta in percentage points), citations_total, top_url, top_url_title, top_domain, role own or competitor. meta.urls_total, domains_total, urls_with_brands. mode sources: cited URLs (level url) or Domains (level domain) with the usual columns (share, delta, citation type, URL type, answers citing it), mentions = up to 20 tracked Brands named on the page or domain, mentions_total, ordered by the number of Brands by default. Use it for: which Brands appear on the cited sources, which sources name the most Brands, where competitors are present on third-party pages. It is presence on sources, never a Visibility driver by itself (use sources_urls and url_detail for that). Untracked Brands are not detected in this data. Default period: the server sets the last 30 days when no dates are given. With brand_id over long periods (above about 90 days) the call is slow; prefer mentioned_brand_ids there.

aufrufe.nur_mira: Nachfolger von source_mentions_overview (n8n); die UI hat dafuer keine Ansicht (22.10.)

mode.beschreibung: brands = one row per tracked Brand with its presence on cited pages; sources = cited URLs or Domains ordered by how many Brands their pages name.

level.beschreibung: Only for mode sources: rows per exact URL (url) or per Domain (domain). On domain level, share_pct is the share of the whole Domain; URL type and search filters only change urls_count and mentions.

mentioned.beschreibung: Page-level: yes / no = only pages whose content names / does not name the OWN Brand (with brand_id: that Brand). Not analysed pages count as no, so no is not proof of absence.

mentioned_brand_ids.beschreibung: Only pages whose content names at least one of these tracked Brands (company ids, OR).

citation_types.beschreibung: Only sources of these Citation Types (who owns the source); answers use the returned citation_type_label.

url_types.beschreibung: Only pages of these URL Types (what kind of page it is).

search.beschreibung: Only pages whose URL contains this text (searches the URL, not the title).

order.beschreibung: mode brands: share_desc (default), share_asc, share_delta_desc, share_delta_asc, urls_desc, domains_desc, name_asc. mode sources: brands_desc (default), brands_asc, share_desc, share_asc, share_delta_desc, share_delta_asc, last_used_desc, domain_asc, plus url_asc (level url) or urls_count_desc (level domain). Other values are rejected.

limit.beschreibung: Rows per page, 1-50; meta.total_count = all matching rows.

offset.beschreibung: Rows to skip for paging. Default 0.

prompt_id.beschreibung: Only citations from answers to this one Prompt.

brand_id.beschreibung: Only citations from answers in which this Brand is named; is_mentioned and mentioned then refer to this Brand. Slow over long periods; prefer mentioned_brand_ids there.

werkzeuge.name: url_summaries
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Page summaries for up to 25 cited URLs at once, for example after sources_urls or sources_brands: title, domain, description, summary (written in the page's own language, may be null; forum and social pages often have none), last_scraped_at and the tracked Brands detected on the page (brands with role). No metrics, no period. Only URLs this team has cited; others come back in meta.not_found. Use the returned url for further calls. Statements about a page come only from these fields; for Citation Conversion of one page use url_detail.

aufrufe.nur_mira: Nachfolger von include_summary in citation_overview (n8n); die UI holt Zusammenfassungen nur einzeln (22.10.)

urls.beschreibung: 1 to 25 exact URLs from earlier results (as returned, e.g. from sources_urls).

werkzeuge.name: domain_detail
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Header facts of one domain, without period: citation_type (effective type used everywhere: You / Competition from the team's brands or a manual override, subdomains inherit it from the parent host; otherwise the source category), citation_type_auto (type without this domain's own override), override (own, competitor or null), company (the tracked brand whose website is this host or its parent host, else null), first_seen / last_seen (the team's first and last citation of the domain over all time; intents and branded only affect these two). A domain that was never cited is not an error (Misc, last_seen null). No share, trend or URLs: use sources_domains (search = the domain), sources_trend and sources_domain_urls for those.

domain.beschreibung: The domain, e.g. adac.de; a URL or a www. form is reduced to the host. Each subdomain is its own domain. An invalid host returns not found.

werkzeuge.name: url_detail
werkzeuge.beschreibung: One cited URL in depth for the period: title, domain, url_type (kind of page), citation_type (owner of its domain), cited_runs (answers citing it), global_share (cited_runs / answers with any citation, %), domain_share (cited_runs / answers citing its domain, %), global_rank (place among all URLs cited in the team's answers, by citing answers), description, summary (AI summary of the page content, in the page's language; null if none), brands[] = tracked brands detected ON the page, and conversion[] for exactly those brands: cited_runs, mentioned_runs (answers citing this URL that also name the brand) and citation_conversion_pct = mentioned_runs / cited_runs. Brands not named on the page get no conversion row. first_cited_at / last_cited_at cover all time and ignore filters; scope_first_cited_at / scope_last_cited_at respect intents and branded. in_range false = not cited in the period (numbers 0, conversion empty); branded_only true = cited in the period only for branded prompts, which are excluded by default. Use meta.url (the resolved spelling) for further calls, and the same period as the rest of the analysis: shares and conversion depend on it.

url.beschreibung: The exact URL, taken from a previous result or the user, never guessed. http/https, www., a trailing slash, #fragments and tracking parameters are normalised. A URL the team's answers never cited returns not found.

werkzeuge.name: responses
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Individual AI answers (one row per model run) for the filters, plus the totals row. Result: liste (rows; meta.total_count) and summe. Row: prompt_run_id (id for response_detail), run_at, model, prompt_id, prompt_text (not for overall Sentiment or its trend: use brands_overview), user_rank and user_sentiment of the measured brand (the own brand, or brand_id if set: its best position in this answer, counting all brands named incl. untracked ones, lower is better), own_mentioned (the OWN brand is named, also with brand_id), companies_preview (tracked brands named, with rank), sources_preview (up to 5 cited sources) with sources_totalcount, response_preview (first 100 characters, for triage only). summe: mention_rate_pct and mentioned_count (answers naming the OWN brand, even with brand_id), avg_rank and rank1_count (measured brand; rank1_count counts answers), avg_sentiment and sentiment_below_50 (measured brand, only the last 30 days of the period; sentiment_below_50 counts answers), avg_brands_per_response and brands_seen (tracked brands only), avg_citations_per_response, responses_with_citations_pct, models_used, top_model / top_model_share, first_date, last_date, responses_last_7d. Previews are not evidence: read an answer with response_detail.

mentioned.beschreibung: yes / no: only answers that name (do not name) the OWN brand, also when brand_id is set. For other brands use brand_ids or brand_id.

brand_ids.beschreibung: Only answers that name at least one of these tracked brands (company ids, any of them). Combined with brand_id and mentioned by AND.

sentiment_min.beschreibung: Only answers where the measured brand (own brand, or brand_id) has a sentiment of at least this (0-100); usually about 70 for a positive analysis. Any rank or sentiment limit drops answers that do not name the measured brand.

sentiment_max.beschreibung: Only answers where the measured brand (own brand, or brand_id) has a sentiment of at most this (0-100); usually about 60 for a negative analysis. Drops answers that do not name the measured brand.

rank_min.beschreibung: Only answers where the measured brand (own brand, or brand_id) is named at this position or later (1 = first; all brands in the answer count). Drops answers that do not name it.

rank_max.beschreibung: Only answers where the measured brand (own brand, or brand_id) is named at this position or earlier, e.g. 3 = top 3. Drops answers that do not name it.

search.beschreibung: Only answers whose PROMPT text contains this text (it does not search the answer text). % and _ act as wildcards.

url.beschreibung: Only answers that cite this exact URL (normalised like url_detail). total_count then equals url_detail cited_runs.

domain.beschreibung: Only answers that cite at least one URL of this domain (host; a URL or www. form is accepted; subdomains are separate domains).

prompt_id.beschreibung: Only answers to this one prompt.

brand_id.beschreibung: Only answers that name this brand; user_rank, user_sentiment, the rank and sentiment filters and the totals' avg_rank / avg_sentiment then refer to it (mentioned and mention_rate_pct stay the own brand). Combined with brand_ids by AND.

order.beschreibung: Sort order; rank_* and sentiment_* put answers without a value for the measured brand last. The set and the totals do not change with the order.

limit.beschreibung: Rows per page, 1-30; liste.meta.total_count = all matching answers.

offset.beschreibung: Rows to skip for paging. Default 0.

werkzeuge.name: response_detail
werkzeuge.beschreibung: One AI answer in full: response_json.text (the answer as given), prompt_text, model, run_at / run_day, market, tags (topics), brands[] (one row per tracked brand: rank = best position in this answer counting all brands named incl. untracked ones, so it can start at 2; ranks[]; mentions; sentiment 0-100), companies[] (one row per mention, with brand_name_raw = spelling in the text), citations[] (sources cited in this answer; their mentions[] = tracked brands detected on that page by page analysis, not in this answer), shopping_products and ads. Only brands the team tracks today appear. The only source for what an answer actually says; for overall Sentiment and its trend use brands_overview.

response_id.beschreibung: prompt_run_id from responses or another result. Unknown or other-team id: not found.

werkzeuge.name: opportunities
werkzeuge.beschreibung: The team's saved Opportunities (Tasks on the board), with filters and paging: each card is one exact URL (lead_url, lead_domain, lead_title) with status (Created = shown as Pending, In Progress, Ignored, Done), recommendation_type and label (the action: Get Listed, Create Matching Content, Improve Existing Content, Build Presence), effective_citation_type, priority_score / priority_label, headline and reason, market, topics, mentioned_competitors, and KPIs stored on the card when it was created (your_conversion, avg_competitor_conversion, gap, global_share_pct, trend_pct): not recalculated for any period, use url_detail for current numbers. When not: this lists saved Tasks only; for a page's current share, conversion or presence use url_detail or the sources tools. meta.total_count = cards in the filter, meta.status_counts = counts per status with all filters except status. Use search to check whether a card for a URL or Domain already exists. Read only: you cannot create, move or change cards.

aufrufe.nur_mira: Nachfolger von source_recommendations (n8n) mit Filtern; die UI zeigt das Brett ueber dashboard_opportunities_v1 (22.10.)

status.beschreibung: Only cards with these statuses; active = Created and In Progress. Created is shown to users as Pending.

recommendation_types.beschreibung: Only cards with these actions (Get Listed, Create Matching Content, Improve Existing Content, Build Presence).

citation_types.beschreibung: Only cards whose source has these Citation Types.

search.beschreibung: Only cards whose URL, Domain, page title or headline contains this text (case and accents ignored).

order.beschreibung: Sort order; share_desc = by the stored citation share, gap_desc = by the stored conversion gap.

limit.beschreibung: Cards per page, 1-50.

offset.beschreibung: Cards to skip for paging. Default 0.

werkzeuge.name: dashboard_kpis
werkzeuge.beschreibung: The account at a glance, as on the Dashboard, in one call: the right first call for a status, summary or 'how are we doing' question. brands.own = the own Brand's visibility_pct (share of answers naming it, %), avg_rank (lower is better), sentiment (0-100, only the last 30 days of the period) and mentions (answers naming it), each with *_delta against the period directly before date_from (half as long: Visibility in percentage points, Rank positive = worse), and position (its place among all tracked Brands by Visibility); brands.field = brand_count, best_rank (best Rank of any Brand) and avg_sentiment (unweighted mean over the Brands); brands.rows = the top 5 Brands by Visibility with the same fields (the own Brand may be outside them, then it is only in own); brands.meta.runs_total = answers in the period. citations.kpis = runs_with_any (answers with at least one citation), citations_total (answer x URL pairs), domains_total, urls_total; citations.types = share_of_citations_pct per Citation Type (adds up to 100). For the full Brand table use brands_overview, for trends brands_visibility_trend, for single sources sources_domains or sources_urls.

werkzeuge.name: performance_radar
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Topic x Brand matrix (Performance radar): how visible each tracked Brand is inside each Topic, for questions like where competitors are strong and the own Brand is missing, or which Brands lead in which Topics. topics[] = one entry per Topic (rows of the matrix, by share of answers) with topic_share_pct (share of all answers in the filter that belong to the Topic; Topics share Prompts, so these add up to more than 100) and brands[] = one cell per Brand: visibility_pct (share of THIS Topic's answers that name the Brand, inside the Brand's tracking window; null = no answers there, which is not 0), visibility_delta_pct (percentage points against the period directly before date_from, half as long), avg_rank (lower is better; null = never named in this Topic), avg_rank_delta (positive = worse), sentiment and sentiment_delta (0-100, last 30 days), mentions (answers naming it in the Topic). brands_overall[] = the same Brands with their values over ALL Topics in the filter (the same numbers as brands_overview) and position. meta.selection: how many Brands and Topics exist in total and how many are shown; without brand_ids the top Brands by Visibility are shown, the own Brand always among them. A Brand or Topic missing from the matrix is only not shown, not absent. For one Brand's line over time in a Topic use brand_metric_trend with topic_ids.

brand_ids.beschreibung: Exactly these Brands as columns (company ids of active tracked Brands, max 12; the own Brand only if included). brand_limit is then ignored. Unknown or other-team ids are an error.

row_topic_ids.beschreibung: Exactly these Topics as rows (tag_id from prompts_meta, max 12); topic_limit is then ignored. Unlike topic_ids it does not narrow the Prompts, it only picks the rows.

brand_limit.beschreibung: Without brand_ids: number of Brands shown, the top Brands by Visibility with the own Brand always included.

topic_limit.beschreibung: Without row_topic_ids: number of Topics shown, those with the largest share of answers first.

werkzeuge.name: brand_metric_trend
werkzeuge.beschreibung: One tracked Brand's Visibility, Rank or Sentiment over time (the line in the Brand drawer and behind a Performance radar cell): points[] with bucket_start (the day, or the Monday of the week, or the first of the month; the first and last bucket are cut by the period, so a bucket_start before date_from is normal) and the value of the chosen metric: visibility_pct (share of the bucket's answers naming the Brand), avg_rank (lower is better) or sentiment (0-100). null = no answers (or no Rank, no Sentiment) in that bucket or outside the Brand's tracking window: a gap, not 0. With topic_ids it is the line inside those Topics, without it over all Prompts. The average of the points is not the value of the period (busy days weigh more); take period values from brands_overview or performance_radar. Use it for Sentiment over time and for one Brand's line in a Topic; for several Brands' Visibility lines at once use brands_visibility_trend.

brand_id.beschreibung: company_id of a tracked Brand of the team, own or competitor (from brands_tracked, search_entities or a previous result). Another team's or an unknown Brand: not found.

metric.beschreibung: Which line: visibility, rank or sentiment.

granularity.beschreibung: Bucket size: day, week (from Monday) or month. Use week from about 30 days and month from about 180 days.

werkzeuge.name: discover_brands
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Brands that AI answers name but the team does NOT track (Discover Brands): candidates for new competitors. rows = names as the answers write them, grouped by spelling (not companies): name, visibility_pct (share of all answers in the filter naming it; the denominator leaves out today until it is recalculated and has no tracking window, so it is close to but not exactly comparable with tracked Brands' Visibility), mentioned_runs (answers naming it), mentioned_count (mentions), status (untracked, or inactive = a deactivated Brand of the team, then with company_id), recognized_domains (domains cited in the same answers whose name matches the Brand, with matched_runs). With matched yes (default) only names with a recognised domain; with matched no also products and variants as separate rows (Tesla, Tesla Model Y), whose values overlap and must never be added. meta: total_count (all candidates; at most limit rows are shown, so a name missing from the list is not proof it is never named: use search), total_responses (the denominator), today_included, missing_days (> 0 = numbers incomplete, say so). Never use it for numbers of tracked Brands (brands_overview).

matched.beschreibung: yes = only names with a recognised domain (the reliable list, as in the app by default); no = every name, including products and variants.

search.beschreibung: Only names or domains containing this text, searched over all candidates, not only the shown ones.

limit.beschreibung: Rows, 1-50, by Visibility; there is no paging, meta.total_count = all candidates.

werkzeuge.name: impact_events
werkzeuge.beschreibung: The team's Impact entries, both kinds, newest first, without numbers. kind event = Event Tracking (did a change such as a relaunch, campaign, launch or article work: before/after around event_date, with a comparison group of other Prompts); kind watch = Citation Tracking (where and how often chosen pages or domains are cited; its event_date is only the creation day). Per entry: id (event_id for the other Impact tools), kind, name, description, event_type, event_date, end_date (set = a campaign from event_date to end_date), status (planned, running, completed = campaign ended), day_number (day since start, while running), affected_prompt_count (Prompts the event is measured on; for watch all active Prompts), comparison_prompt_count, target_count and target_kinds (url = one exact page, path = everything under a path, host = a domain, host_all = a domain with its subdomains), target_hosts, new_page_count / new_page_cited_count (sitemap pages new since event_date / of those already cited). For results call impact_event_analysis.

werkzeuge.name: impact_event_analysis
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Results of one Impact entry. event = its setup: name, kind, event_type, event_date, end_date, status, topics, the tracked pages (urls) and targets (id = target_id for impact_target_urls and impact_sitemap_coverage, kind, value). windows = the compared periods: before_from..before_to and after (requested_after_from..effective_after_to); the event day is in neither; after_complete false = the after window is still running, results are preliminary; limited_baseline = little data before. For a campaign the middle window is during (event_date..end_date) and after_campaign is the follow-up. cohort: affected_prompt_count, comparable_prompt_count (only Prompts and models with data both before and after count in the numbers) and comparison_prompt_count. Event Tracking only: own_brand_in_affected_prompts and own_brand_in_comparison_prompts with visibility (% of answers naming the own Brand), rank (lower is better, negative delta = better), sentiment (0-100), each {before, after or during, delta, after_campaign}, mention_runs and total_runs (sample sizes: the two windows can differ in length, so never compare raw counts); effect_vs_comparison = the own Brand's change minus the comparison group's change (the best estimate of the event's effect; delta alone also contains changes that happened everywhere); competitors_in_affected_prompts; sample_size per metric (answers and Prompts before and after); trend (own Brand and comparison group per bucket). Both kinds: urls = exact-URL targets with global_share (% of answers with a citation that cite the URL; never add up across URLs), runs_with_url and first_cited (when it was first cited after the event); targets with citations (citations of the target's pages), share_of_citations (its citations / all citations, %; a different denominator than global_share), new_urls (pages first cited in the window), matched_url_count and daily. overlaps = other entries in the same period that share Prompts and may blur the effect. Observational, not proof: say so, and name small samples (under about 50 answers per side) as too little data. Citation Tracking (kind watch) compares the last window_days with the window_days before and has no brand numbers here. The cited pages of a target: impact_target_urls.

event_id.beschreibung: id from impact_events. Another team's or a deleted entry: not found.

window_days.beschreibung: Length of the before and after windows in days: 7, 30, 90 or 180 as in the app (default 30). Ignored for a campaign (its windows come from start and end). Omit it together with window since.

window.beschreibung: since = everything since the event (single-date Event Tracking without end date only; window_days is then ignored); omit for window_days.

granularity.beschreibung: Bucket size of trend and daily: day, week (from Monday) or month. Use day only for windows of 7 days.

werkzeuge.name: impact_target_urls
werkzeuge.beschreibung: The cited pages of one target of an Impact entry (path, domain or domain with subdomains; not for exact-URL targets, those are in impact_event_analysis urls): one row per URL with title, first_cited_day (first citation by the affected Prompts, any model and market, all history), days_after_event (Event Tracking only: first_cited_day minus event_date; negative = cited before the event), citations_after (citations in the after window; for a campaign during it; for Citation Tracking the last window_days), prompts_after, models_after, global_share_after (% of answers with a citation in that window that cite the URL), branded_only (cited in the window only by branded Prompts, which are excluded by default; numbers 0). total = rows matching the search, total_all = all, total_branded_only. event = name, kind and dates of the entry. Same filters and window as impact_event_analysis.

target_id.beschreibung: targets[].id from impact_event_analysis (a path or domain target; an exact-URL target is an error).

window_days.beschreibung: Window length in days as in impact_event_analysis (default 30).

window.beschreibung: since = everything since the event (single-date Event Tracking only); omit for window_days.

search.beschreibung: Only URLs or titles containing this text.

order.beschreibung: Sort by citations_after, first citation, Prompts, models or URL.

limit.beschreibung: Rows per page, 1-50.

offset.beschreibung: Rows to skip for paging. Default 0.

werkzeuge.name: impact_sitemap_coverage
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Sitemap coverage of the path and domain targets of an Impact entry: which pages from the site's sitemap AI answers cite and which not yet. Per target: status of the sitemap read (ok, pending = never read, or an error), page_count (pages stored), cited_count (pages ever cited by the tracked Prompts, all history), new_count (pages new or changed since event_date), missing_count (gone from the sitemap), cited_outside_sitemap (cited pages of the target that are not in the sitemap), branded_only_count, pages_total (pages in the chosen filter) and pages: page_url, cited, first_cited_day, citations_since_event (Event Tracking: citations from the day after event_date) or citations_since_created (Citation Tracking: since the entry was created, so not the same window as impact_target_urls), is_new, missing_since, lastmod, branded_only. 'Cited' means ever cited, not cited in a window. event = name, kind and dates of the entry.

target_id.beschreibung: Only this target (targets[].id from impact_event_analysis, a path or domain target). Omit for all targets.

pages.beschreibung: Which pages to list: all, cited, not_cited (never cited yet) or new (new or changed since event_date).

search.beschreibung: Only pages whose address contains this text.

limit.beschreibung: Pages per target, 0-100; 0 = only the counts.

offset.beschreibung: Pages to skip per target. Default 0.

werkzeuge.name: shopping_overview
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Product cards in AI answers (Shopping; observed only in ChatGPT, since 3 October 2026; an observation = one product shown in one answer), overview and Brand table for the period. meta.period (from is never before 3 October) and comparison_available (false = no previous values; the comparison period has the same length and can be cut at the data start); meta.totals: runs_with_known_state (answers checked for product cards), runs_with_shopping, observations, products. kpis of the OWN Brand, each {value, previous, delta} (delta in percentage points): shopping_rate (share of answers with any product cards, Brand-independent), brand_presence (share of answers with product cards that show at least one own product), share_of_shelf (own observations / all observations), first_position_rate (answers where an own product is first in the list / all answers with a product list), avg_position (lower is better). brands = tracked Brands with the same values per Brand plus rank, observations, products and top_product; not_tracked_brands_combined = all products without a tracked Brand together (never a Brand called Other). brands_summary, top_products (10 products with the highest shopping_visibility_pct), movement (rising and declining products, only with a comparison; status new = not seen before), merchant_distribution (top merchants by share_of_merchant_mentions_pct). Merchants are raw names (amazon.de, Amazon.de and Amazon.de - Amazon.de-Seller are three rows). Product IDs and merchant names changed format around 9 to 12 October, so comparisons across those days show apparent new or gone items. Prices are as shown in the answer, not shop prices.

brand_search.beschreibung: Only tracked Brands whose name contains this text (brands table only).

brand_order.beschreibung: Sort order of the brands table; rank does not change with it.

brand_offset.beschreibung: Brands to skip for paging. Default 0.

werkzeuge.name: shopping_products
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Products shown as product cards in AI answers in the period (ChatGPT only, since 3 October 2026), one row per product: product_id (for shopping_product_detail), title, brand (name, type own, competitor or other = no tracked Brand), shopping_visibility_pct (share of answers with product cards that showed this product, {value, previous, delta}), observations (answers that showed it), avg_position (lower is better; null = only shown as a single card), first_position_share_of_its_answers_pct (answers where it was first / answers that showed it; a different denominator than the Brand's first_position_rate), price_ranges per currency (as shown in the answers, across pack sizes), rating, merchants, merchant_count, first_seen, last_seen. total_count = products in the segment; segment_counts = all, you (own Brand), competition (tracked competitors), other (no tracked Brand). previous 0 = not seen in the comparison period.

segment.beschreibung: you = own Brand's products, competition = tracked competitors', other = products without a tracked Brand.

search.beschreibung: Only products whose title or tracked Brand name contains this text.

merchant.beschreibung: Only products offered by this exact merchant name (as returned by shopping_merchants).

brand_id.beschreibung: Only products of this tracked Brand (company_id). Other-team ids are an error.

limit.beschreibung: Rows per page, 1-50; total_count = all matching products.

offset.beschreibung: Rows to skip for paging. Default 0.

werkzeuge.name: shopping_product_detail
werkzeuge.beschreibung: One product in AI answers (Shopping). product = header from its latest observation ever (title, brand, latest_price, rating, last_seen; independent of filters and period) plus price_ranges, merchant_count and first_seen for the period. kpis {value, previous, delta}: shopping_visibility_pct (share of answers with product cards that showed it), observations, avg_position (lower is better), first_position_share_of_its_answers_pct. trend per day: shopping_visibility_pct, observations, avg_position and its Brand's presence and position as reference (null = no answer with product cards that day). topics, models, markets with share_of_its_answers_pct (share of the answers showing this product; can add up to more than 100). merchants with share_of_its_merchant_mentions_pct and prices. appearances = the answers that showed it, newest first: prompt_text, run_at, model, market, position (null = single card), is_first, price, merchant_name, prompt_run_id (the answer, for response_detail).

product_id.beschreibung: product_id from shopping_products or shopping_overview, exactly as returned (text, never a number). A product never observed in this team: not found.

limit.beschreibung: Appearances per page, 1-50.

werkzeuge.name: shopping_merchants
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Merchants named on product cards in AI answers (ChatGPT only, since 3 October 2026), one row per raw merchant name: rank (by observations, independent of order and search), observations ({value, previous, delta}: product cards naming the merchant), share_of_merchant_mentions_pct ({value, previous, delta}: its observations / all observations that name a merchant), products, tracked_brands (tracked Brands among its products, own included), has_unassigned_products, avg_position, first_seen, last_seen. summary for the whole period: merchants, products, observations (with a merchant), top_merchant. Raw names: the same shop can appear under several names (amazon.de, Amazon.de, Amazon.de - Amazon.de-Seller); say so when you combine them. Merchant names changed format around 9 to 12 October.

search.beschreibung: Only merchants whose name contains this text.

limit.beschreibung: Rows per page, 1-50; total_count = all matching merchants.

offset.beschreibung: Rows to skip for paging. Default 0.

werkzeuge.name: page_audits
werkzeuge.beschreibung: The team's Page Audits (a technical check whether AI search platforms can reach a page and read its text; no citations, no score). One row per audited page: page_id (for page_audit_detail), url, host, title, schedule (once, weekly, monthly), next_run_at, run_count. latest = the newest run (status queued, running, completed, partial, failed, cancelled); result = the newest finished result, which can be older than latest: assessment (restriction_detected = at least one platform is blocked, potential_issue = reachable but something may limit use, no_tested_obstacle = nothing found in the tested points, which is no proof of indexing or citation, inconclusive), reachable_count of profile_count (platforms that can reach the page: 'Reachable for 7 of 7'), restriction_count, issue_count, coverage_satisfied / coverage_required (measurements done / needed; partial runs are incomplete), http_status, previous_reachable_count (the result before), rules_changed (the ruleset changed since then, so the two are not comparable). meta.quota = the weekly audit allowance: allowance, used, remaining, resets_at (Monday 00:00 Berlin). Reading costs nothing; this tool cannot start an audit.

search.beschreibung: Only audited pages whose address or title contains this text (case-insensitive).

order.beschreibung: Sort key: last_run (newest run), url, reachable (reachable platforms), issues (restrictions first, then potential issues), status, schedule, next_run.

direction.beschreibung: desc = highest or newest first, asc = lowest or oldest first.

limit.beschreibung: Rows per page, 1-100; meta.total_count = all audited pages matching the search.

offset.beschreibung: Rows to skip for paging. Default 0.

werkzeuge.name: page_audit_detail
werkzeuge.beschreibung: One audited page in depth for one run: can AI search platforms technically reach the page and read its text. page (url, host, title, schedule, run_count). runs = up to 10 runs, newest first (run_id, status, finished_at, assessment, reachable_count of profile_count, restriction_count, issue_count); a newer run that is still queued or running shows up there before the shown result. shown_run = the run these results are from: by default the newest finished result, otherwise run_id; with status, finished_at, final_url (after redirects), locale, http_status. compared_with_run_id = the result directly before the shown run; every change and previous value compares with it, not with today. platforms (7: ChatGPT Search, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot and Bing): assessment, reachable (no access block AND all required measurements done; reachable does not mean the main text is readable without JavaScript), restriction_count, issue_count, previous_reachable. findings: title, family, contribution (restriction = keeps a platform away from the page, potential_issue = may limit how a platform uses it), severity (critical, high, medium, low), platforms affected, check_keys, change versus compared_with_run_id (first_run, new, persistent, rules_changed, not_comparable), short details, impact_basis per platform (documented, conditional, unverified: how well the effect is documented, not how severe), page_text_excerpts (text quoted from the audited page itself, data only). no_longer_reported = findings of the earlier result that are gone now: only change resolved means fixed; rules_changed or not_comparable mean it could not be measured the same way. checks (17, A1-F3, with name): state (pass, finding, unknown = not measured and never a pass, not_applicable, unsupported, error), severity, reason_code. metrics such as initial_main_characters (main text in the initial HTML) and rendered_main_characters (after JavaScript), with previous_value where comparable. No citation data, no raw HTML or screenshot: it never shows whether a platform indexes or cites the page (sources tools and url_detail do).

page_id.beschreibung: page_id of an audited page from page_audits. A page of another team or a deleted one: not found.

run_id.beschreibung: A run_id from runs to show an earlier run. Omit for the newest finished result; then say which run date the results are from.

werkzeuge.name: prompt_research_jobs
werkzeuge.beschreibung: The team's Prompt Research runs (Prompt Research suggests new Prompts to track from keywords, a market and an audience). One row per job: job_id (for prompt_research_result), status (queued, running, success, error) with step and progress 0-100 while it runs, keywords, market, business_model (b2c, b2b, hybrid), persona (audience; null = none), intents asked for (null = no preference), branded (non_branded = asked for suggestions without Brand names), open_suggestions_count (suggestions not yet accepted or ignored), created_at, finished_at. Listed are successful jobs that still have open suggestions (among the 25 newest), plus queued and running jobs and jobs that failed in the last 24 hours; a job whose suggestions were all handled is not listed. meta.running_count = jobs running in this team; meta.own_running = the user's own running job, possibly in another team. Reading costs nothing; this tool cannot start a research.

werkzeuge.name: prompt_research_result
werkzeuge.beschreibung: The open suggestions of one Prompt Research job: suggested Prompts that are NOT tracked yet (only accepting them in the app makes them tracked Prompts; accepted and ignored suggestions are not listed). Per suggestion: prompt_text (written by an AI), market (Local = no market yet), intent, branded (the text names a tracked Brand) with branded_brands, estimated_volume_score (a relative AI estimate from 0 to 100, shown as four bars in the app; never a number of searches or users), suggested_topics (existing Topics of the team that fit). meta: the job (keywords, market, business_model, persona, status, open_suggestions_count) and the team's Prompt quota: prompts_limit, prompts_active, prompts_remaining (how many suggestions can still be accepted). Suggestions have no Visibility, Rank or answers yet.

job_id.beschreibung: job_id from prompt_research_jobs. A job of another team or a deleted one: not found.

werkzeuge.name: ads_overview
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Ads in AI answers (paid ad cards inside AI answers; observed only in ChatGPT, since 2 October 2026), overview for the period. kpis: ad_coverage_pct = share of the tracked answers in the filter that showed at least one ad (the denominator counts answers of all models and markets in the filter, so without models [chatgpt] the value is diluted by models that never show ads); advertisers = distinct advertiser names; ad_appearances = ads observed (the same ad in two answers counts twice: presence in answers, not budget, spend or impressions); prompts_with_ads and tracked_prompts = active Prompts with at least one ad / with answers. trend: one row per day with total_runs, runs_with_ads, ad_coverage_pct, ad_appearances. advertiser_share: the top 10 advertisers by ad_appearances with ad_share_pct (their appearances / all ad appearances in the filter). topics: per Topic ad_coverage_pct (answers to that Topic's Prompts with an ad), advertiser_count, ad_appearances; Topics share Prompts, so never add them up. recent_ads: the 6 newest ads (advertiser, title, description, ad_format, price, landing_domain, Prompt, model, market, observed_at). There is no comparison period: for a change call it twice with two periods. An advertiser is the name on the ad, not a tracked Brand: one company can advertise under several names (BMW and BMW USA are two advertisers). Several topic_ids always combine with or here. At most two Ads tools at once.

advertisers.beschreibung: Only ads of these advertisers, by exact advertiser_name as returned by ads_advertisers (case and spaces matter; an unknown name is an error).

ad_formats.beschreibung: Only these ad formats: image_card_v2 = Image Ad, product_card_v2 = Product Ad (with a price). Ads without a format drop out once this is set.

werkzeuge.name: ads_advertisers
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Advertisers whose ads appeared in AI answers in the period (ChatGPT only, since 2 October 2026), one row per advertiser_name (the exact name on the ad, the key for ads_advertiser_detail and the advertisers filter): company_id and relationship (you = the own Brand, competitor = a tracked competitor, null = not tracked by the team; the link comes from the ads, one company can advertise under several names), domain, ad_share_pct (its appearances / all ad appearances in the filter), ad_appearances (ads observed; presence, not spend), prompt_count (active Prompts where its ads appeared), topic_count, markets, ad_formats, first_seen / last_seen in the period. meta: total_count. No comparison period. Use search to resolve an advertiser name before filtering. At most two Ads tools at once.

search.beschreibung: Only advertisers whose name contains this text (case-insensitive substring).

order.beschreibung: Sort order; ties by appearances, then name.

advertisers.beschreibung: Only these advertisers, by exact advertiser_name (case and spaces matter; an unknown name is an error).

ad_formats.beschreibung: Only ads of these formats: image_card_v2 = Image Ad, product_card_v2 = Product Ad (with a price).

limit.beschreibung: Rows per page, 1-50; total_count = all matching advertisers.

offset.beschreibung: Rows to skip for paging. Default 0.

werkzeuge.name: ads_advertiser_detail
werkzeuge.beschreibung: One advertiser in AI answers for the period: advertiser (name, company_id and relationship you / competitor / null, domain, landing_domains = where its ads lead, possibly tracking hosts, ad_formats, first_seen / last_seen), summary (ad_appearances, prompt_count, topic_count, ad_share_pct = its appearances / all ad appearances in the filter), trend (one row per day: ad_appearances and ad_share_pct of that day's ads), topics, prompts (active Prompts where its ads appeared, most appearances first: prompt_text, ad_appearances, last_seen, and organic_visibility_pct = share of that Prompt's answers in the period whose regular answer text names the advertiser's company, organic_mentioned; both null when the company is not tracked by the team, which means not measurable, not no), ads (the 20 newest: title, description, ad_format, price, landing_domain, Prompt, model, market, observed_at). An unknown advertiser_name returns empty data, not an error: then say it was not found. No comparison period.

advertiser_name.beschreibung: The exact advertiser_name from ads_advertisers or ads_overview (case and spaces matter).

werkzeuge.name: ads_library
werkzeuge.beschreibung: The ads themselves (Ad Library), newest first: one row per ad observed in an answer (the same creative seen twice is two rows): advertiser_name, company_id, title and description (the advertiser's own text, any language), ad_format (image_card_v2 = Image Ad, product_card_v2 = Product Ad), price / price_str / currency (Product Ads only), landing_domain, prompt_id and prompt_text (the Prompt whose answer showed it), topics, model, market, observed_at, prompt_run_id (the answer, for response_detail). total_count = all matching ads. Use it to read what ads say (offers, prices, claims) or which ads appear for a Prompt (search with words of the Prompt; it also matches other Prompts containing them). ChatGPT only, since 2 October 2026. At most two Ads tools at once.

search.beschreibung: Only ads whose title, description, advertiser, landing domain or Prompt text contains this text (case-insensitive substring).

advertisers.beschreibung: Only ads of these advertisers, by exact advertiser_name (case and spaces matter; an unknown name is an error).

ad_formats.beschreibung: Only these formats: image_card_v2 = Image Ad, product_card_v2 = Product Ad (with a price).

limit.beschreibung: Ads per page, 1-50; total_count = all matching ads.

offset.beschreibung: Ads to skip for paging. Default 0.

werkzeuge.name: ads_prompts
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Active Prompts and how often their AI answers showed ads in the period (ChatGPT only, since 2 October 2026): prompt_id, prompt_text, topics, total_runs (answers), runs_with_ads, ad_coverage_pct (runs_with_ads / total_runs), advertiser_count, ad_appearances, last_ad_seen. Without advertisers or ad_formats every active Prompt with answers is listed, also those without any ad; with one of them only Prompts with a matching ad, and the numbers count only those ads. total_count = matching Prompts. At most two Ads tools at once.

search.beschreibung: Only Prompts whose text contains this text (case-insensitive substring).

advertisers.beschreibung: Only Prompts with ads of these advertisers, by exact advertiser_name (an unknown name is an error).

ad_formats.beschreibung: Only Prompts with ads of these formats: image_card_v2 = Image Ad, product_card_v2 = Product Ad.

limit.beschreibung: Rows per page, 1-50; total_count = all matching Prompts.

offset.beschreibung: Rows to skip for paging. Default 0.

werkzeuge.name: get_knowledge
werkzeuge.beschreibung: Background knowledge on GEO/AEO, metric definitions, citation and URL types and how upstreem works, by slug from the knowledge index in the instructions. Never a source of the team's numbers. An unknown slug returns an error with the available slugs.

slugs.beschreibung: 1-4 slugs, exactly as listed in the knowledge index of the instructions.
